sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are mother-in-law and father-in-law of the O.P. No. 02 and whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.

It is also submitted that husband of the O.P. No. 02 instituted matrimonial case No. 1265 of 2018 in the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna, seeking divorce from the O.P. No. 02, in which, the O.P. No. 02 had appeared on 25.10.2019 and filed her written statement, and thereafter,
the present criminal case came to be instituted.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
